_readme: Everything written on the account page: the sign-in panel and the signed-in profile (orders, subscription, addresses, details, the fuel tally). Field labels shared with checkout come from checkout.json. `demo` is SAMPLE data shown to reviewers until the backend supplies real accounts and orders.

signin.title: Sign in to reorder in one tap.
signin.lead: No password to remember. We email you a link, you tap it, you’re in.
signin.sent: Link sent. In this preview you’re signed in straight away.

orders.title: Orders
orders.empty: No orders yet. Your first plate is one tap away.
orders.tracking: Courier tracking arrives with the shop launch.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.lead: A weekly drop you pick once, delivered cold every Monday. Skip or pause any week, no fees.
subscription.toast: You’re first in line when subscriptions open.

demo._note: SAMPLE account for the preview. Real accounts come from the backend (docs/API-CONTRACT.md).
